title: How Turning Your Screen Gray Exposes What's Discipling You
caption:
Every app is tuned to reward you in bright color. Strip it and you strip half the pull. What's left is what you were actually chasing.

You're not failing every time you unlock your phone out of habit. You're being formed by whatever you reach for first.

Turn it gray for a week. Watch what drops away.

#faith #discipleship #phone #selfcontrol #christianmen #manofgod
